scientific_integrity: Exact bounded enumeration and a symbolic infinite cutoff, with an independent Apéry-set arithmetic check; no independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for symmetry of semigroups generated by three consecutive ordinary hexagonal numbers; no universal Frobenius closed form or longer tuple classification. Classical three-generator theorem is assumed from cited primary paper. Published originality may be incomplete owing to unindexed sources.
title: The six symmetric numerical semigroups from consecutive hexagonal numbers
